title: The Rate of the Delsarte Bound for Binary Codes and Spheres
summary: We give the asymptotic rate of Delsarte's linear programming bound for binary codes and spherical codes. This extends previous work of the author which formulated and proved an analogue of the conjecture of Afkhami-Jeddi, Cohn, Hartman, de Laat, and Tajdini for binary codes, obtaining the rate of the Delsarte linear program at distance $1/2-1/π$. The lower bounds introduce ideas from potential theory into the study of Delsarte's bounds, whereby the measures underlying a system of orthogonal polynomials give an obstacle problem.
